Discover the timeless wisdom of the Upanishads in Episode 01 – Journey of Life | Upanishad Ganga, a powerful spiritual series from Chinmaya Mission. This inspiring episode explores self-discovery, purpose of life, happiness, ancient Indian knowledge, Vedanta philosophy, Sanskrit heritage, Hindu spirituality, inner peace, consciousness, and the eternal question Who Am I? Learn how Upanishadic teachings remain deeply relevant in modern life through practical wisdom, mind clarity, values, culture, and spiritual awakening.
